steps.title: Search your route
steps.text: Tell us where you're headed and we'll show the highways and stops that get you there.

steps.title: Pick your stop
steps.text: Choose the pickup and drop-off points closest to you on the route.

steps.title: Book & go
steps.text: Confirm your trip and you're set — no queuing at the stage.

features.title: Smart route search
features.text: Type any two stops and we'll map the quickest matatu and bus connections across the city.

features.title: Stop-by-stop guidance
features.text: See every stage on the way so you always know exactly where to hop on and off.

features.title: Live departures
features.text: Get realistic departure times and never miss the matatu that gets you there on time.

features.title: Safe & trusted
features.text: Verified operators and transparent fares, so your daily commute stays predictable.
